Leyla (CS): Heads-up: SaharaNet needs a short promo onboarding next month. Requirements: me-west-1 routing, partner CIDR allowlist, SAML SSO, and a temporary QPS increase for peak hours during Ramadan campaign. They also raised a future Private deploy + KMS ask; renewal may hinge on data residency evidence.

Omar (SaharaNet): Correct. Promo dates 2025-04-12 -> 2025-04-26. Peak window 07:00-22:00 GST. Baseline QPS 180, target burst 850 for /v1/generate. Will provide SAML metadata and partner IPs.

Priya (NetOps): Please paste IPs and egress expectations. We can open peering to me-west-1 but need to reserve PoP. Auto-revoke allowlist entries OK?

Omar (SaharaNet): CIDRs: 196.45.200.0/24, 196.45.201.77/32. Egress ~250Mbps peak. Auto-revoke required. No client certs initially.

Hana (Solutions Eng): Proposed steps: 1) create ephemeral allowlist for those CIDRs with auto-revoke 2025-04-27; 2) apply temp QPS profile "sahara-promo-850" scoped to me-west-1 and routes /v1/generate (embeddings unchanged, cap 150 concurrent if needed); 3) schedule 30m SAML setup call; 4) open Private deploy discovery ticket for KMS/attestation.

Diego (AE): Renewal note: customer requested a short region-residency log bundle and a KMS isolation note for procurement. I'll draft the artifact with Security.

Leyla (CS): I'll set the SAML call for tomorrow 09:00 GST and prepare a concise runbook. Omar, confirm whether any other routes (webhooks, re-rank) need the promo QPS.

Omar (SaharaNet): Only /v1/generate. We'll keep webhooks at normal levels.

Priya (NetOps): Provision checklist: - Open peering request me-west-1 and reserve PoP - Apply allowlist 196.45.200.0/24, 196.45.201.77/32 (auto-revoke 2025-04-27T00:00:00Z) - Create policy sahara-promo-850 active 07:00-22:00 GST - Monitor: alert at 75% capacity -> escalate to @Leyla.

infra-bot: Created ticket CS-8204. PoP reservation ETA 22h. Staging config applied; promo profile queued; auto-revoke scheduled.

Hana (Solutions Eng): I'll attach SAML test matrix and Console steps (ACS URL, SP EntityID, attr mappings email/name/org) to CS-8204.

Diego (AE): I'll own the renewal artifact and coordinate with Security. ETA: EOD tomorrow.

Leyla (CS): Recap in CS-8204: peering + ephemeral allowlist + promo profile + SAML call tomorrow 09:00 GST. Renewal artifact assigned to Diego. Ping here for any changes.

Omar (SaharaNet): Thanks team, please ensure allowlist auto-revokes and audit log captured.

Priya (NetOps): Noted; audit trail + revoke timer enabled. Will post CS-8204 updates once PoP reserved.

(END)
